QuestInfo.name: The Dark Lord's Diary
QuestInfo.0: You wonder what it says in the Dark Lord's Diary.
QuestInfo.1: The Dark Lord's diary mentioned Jeppi, the owner of the Kerning City bookstore. The very same Jeppi that the Dark Lord banished. It might be worth talking to him, but first you'll have to track him down. Mr. Pickall might know where Jeppi is.

0.0: I've pored through the Dark Lord's Diary. Extensively. All of his innermost secrets and thoughts have been exposed, as is only fair. Anyway, he mentions #bJeppi, the owner of the Kerning City bookstore#k. The one he banished a while back.
0.1: Jeppi must have discovered the truth about the Dark Lord. We must talk to him. Unfortunately, we have no idea where he is.

yes.0: Jeppi's bookstore was next door to Mr. Pick all. #bMr. Pickall#k might know where he's gone.

no.0: If you want to do things your own way, be my guest.

1.0: There is no lock that I cannot open. Just show it to me, and I will-- Hey! You don't even have a lock! You want to know about my old neighbor, Jeppi?

npc.0: You still haven't gone to meet #bMr. Pickall#k? Are you waiting for him to send you an invitation?

1.1: Jeppi moved to Ellinia. To be precise, he doesn't live in Ellinia. He lives in #rGiant Tree#k, nearby.
1.2: But why are you asking that? Is there a particular book you want to read? If that's the case, you'd be better off going to the Ellinia Magic Library.
